_doc: Render golden anchor (scheme §11 / §2.2). The frozen main_pixel_hash is ENV-DEPENDENT: it is only valid under the captured env_digest (chromium build + platform + playwright + pinned flags). A run whose live env_digest differs MUST SKIP the strict-hash assertion (see GOLDEN-README). The double-render equality (determinism) and ready state-machine assertions hold env-independently.
